name: Operation Hedgerow
blurb: Break through the hedgerows and find the tank that the radio crews say glows at night.

start.text: Able Squad, this is Hearth. You're through the beach line. Push inland along the hedgerows.
Recon keeps reporting a Vossmark tank that shrugs off bazookas. Some say it glows. Probably nerves.

mid.text: There's an MG bunker covering the crossroads. You won't get the column past it.

end.text: That's it. That's the tank. Look at the hull.
Hearth to Able. Those marks are not paint. Whatever the Lantern Bureau did to it, put it down.

win.text: Good work, Able. The column moves at dawn. Bring what's left of that relic back to base. Carefully.

name: Operation Frostfall
blurb: The Lantern Bureau has a camp deep in the pines. Something answers their radios.

start.text: Able, Hearth. That relic you brought back keeps humming. Intelligence traced its signal here.
Lovely. A haunted forest in January.

mid.text: A tank is guarding the logging road. Break it and the camp is open.

end.text: Hearth, the singing stopped. There's something standing in the clearing.
Then it can bleed. Light it up, Able.

win.text: Signal's gone dark. Come home, Able. Next operation is the coast. We'll talk when you're back.
